entries.title: See when a crewmate is waiting for the batch
entries.body: Two cyan arcs now distinguish a pull request in the batch from one still waiting for its own checks. The arcs turn slowly during a batch run and stay still while it waits or pauses. The Tasks panel says batch, with the same mark on your phone.

picture.alt: The Tasks panel shows batch rows with a dot between two arcs, beside a checks row with a dashed ring.
